Card Q&A.q: Is the "while you have no face-up security cards" condition met when I have 0 cards in my security stack?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can.  In such cases, you can't add a card from your security stack to your hand, therefore you only place this card in your security stack.
Card Q&A.q: Can I also activate this card's [Main] effect when I have 0 cards in my security stack?

Card Q&A.a: They become face-up security cards that remain revealed.  Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.
Card Q&A.q: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?

Card Q&A.a: The check is performed with the card left revealed.  Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard checks.
Card Q&A.q: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?

Card Q&A.a: Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards.  After shuffling, those cards are left face-down.
Card Q&A.q: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it's prevented from being deleted.  Even if an activated effect is lost, the processing is performed until it ends.
Card Q&A.q: I have 1 [Junomon] and 1 yellow or purple [TS] trait Digimon.  When both of those 2 of my Digimon would be deleted at the same time, the  gained from this card's effect was activated by 1 of my Digimon, and that [Junomon] was deleted.  At such times, I no longer have a Digimon with [Junomon] in its name so  is lost, but is my Digimon that activated  prevented from being deleted?

Effect: While you have no face-up security cards, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
{Security} [All Turns] All of your yellow or purple [TS] trait Digimon gain ＜Alliance＞. While you have a Digimon with [Junomon] in its name, they also gain ＜Scapegoat＞.

[Main] Add your bottom security card to the hand and place this card face up as the bottom security card. Then, you may play 1 yellow or purple [TS] trait Digimon card from your hand with the cost reduced by 3.
Security Effect: [Security] You may play 1 level 4 or lower yellow or purple [TS] trait Digimon card from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
